title: About me
text:
Background
I hold a degree in Biological Sciences and a Master’s and PhD in Ecology and Conservation.
My research experience combines ecological theory, biodiversity conservation, computational methods and disease ecology.
Currently, I work as a postdoctoral researcher developing approaches to understand the effects of environmental change on ecological communities and host–parasite interactions.
